faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.intro: The essentials on working with a freelance CRA.

what.a: A freelance CRA (Clinical Research Associate) is an independent professional who handles the monitoring and operational follow-up of clinical trials. They perform the same duties as an employed CRA — site visits, data verification, compliance follow-up — but work on a service basis, for a defined assignment or period, with no relationship of subordination.

why.q: Why work with a freelance CRA?
why.a: Working with a freelance CRA lets you quickly align resources with real activity: reinforcement during a peak, temporary cover, a one-off monitoring need, or field expertise for a first trial. Independence brings flexibility, responsiveness and a single point of contact, without permanently adding to your structure.

cost.q: How much does a freelance CRA cost?
cost.a: A freelance CRA usually charges a daily rate. It depends on several factors: seniority and specialisation, the nature and duration of the assignment, therapeutic areas, geographic zones and the volume of visits. The freelance model avoids the fixed costs of hiring and scales to the real need. Feel free to contact me for a discussion tailored to your project.
